titel: Is your model secretly in two pieces? Fix it in Blender 🔧 #blender #3dprinting

eind.zin: A new Blender tip for 3D printing every week.

printzin: Measured in Blender, not print tested by us yet.

scenes.tekst: Is your model secretly in two pieces? Check it in Blender.
scenes.label: QUICK TIP

scenes.tekst: See the soft line in the middle? That is your clue.
scenes.label: LOOK

scenes.tekst: Press Tab, point at the top, and press L.
scenes.label: STEP 1

scenes.tekst: Only the top lights up. Blender sees two loose parts.
scenes.label: WHY

scenes.tekst: The seam has 48 double points, so the edge is open.
scenes.uitspraak: The seam has forty eight double points, so the edge is open.
scenes.label: WHY

scenes.tekst: Then press M and pick By Distance.
scenes.label: STEP 2

scenes.tekst: Blender removed 48 points. The seam is closed.
scenes.uitspraak: Blender removed forty eight points. The seam is closed.
scenes.label: RESULT

scenes.tekst: Press Alt A, then L again. Now the whole vase lights up.
scenes.label: STEP 3

scenes.tekst: Do this check on every model you join or import.
scenes.label: TIP

scenes.tekst: Measured in Blender, not print tested by us yet. Save this before your next export.
scenes.label: HONEST
